verdict.rationale: The evidence shows bills and vendors only as ledger data: the MCP tools can read them, and the cash forecast draws on open bills. Nothing documents a bill-capture workflow, approval routing, or payment scheduling, so the core accounts-payable workflow in this story is unevidenced. The generic PDF/CSV import via Accounting AI is not documented as bill capture and does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can capture vendor bills, route them for approval, and schedule payments from one workflow
